changeSet.sql:
set identity_insert [security].[Rule] on; insert into [security].[Rule] (ID, Uid, Name, RoleID, SecurityType, AssetTypeId, ApplyToType, IsVisible, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn) select r.ID, r.Uid, r.Name, r.ResponsibilityTypeID, 2 as SecurityType, a.ID as AssetTypeId, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, r.CreatedBy, r.CreatedOn, r.UpdatedBy, r.UpdatedOn from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r left join AssetType a on a.Object = r.Object and a.ObjectID = r.ObjectID set identity_insert [security].[Rule] off;
-- Set the security type ( [G]roup OR [U]ser ) update t set t.SecurityType = s.SecurityType from [security].[Rule] t inner join ( select r.ID, iif(sec.[Object] = 'GroupType', 1, 2) as SecurityType from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r cross apply openjson(r.Definition) with ( [Then] nvarchar(max) as json ) d cross apply openjson(d.[Then]) with ( Object varchar(50) ) sec ) s on s.ID = t.Id;

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: insert into [security].RuleThen select r.ID, row_number() over(partition by r.Id order by r.Id) as [Position], iif(ti.FieldTypeID = 0 and ti.FieldTypeName = 'Name', 1, ti.[Operator]) as Operator, iif(ti.FieldTypeID > 0, ti.FieldTypeID, null) as FieldTypeId, iif(ti.FieldTypeID > 0, ti.[Value], null) as [Value], iif(ti.FieldTypeID = 0 and ti.FieldTypeName = 'Name', ti.[Value], null) as SecurityId from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r cross apply openjson(r.Definition) with ( [Then] nvarchar(max) as json ) d cross apply openjson(d.[Then]) with ( --Object varchar(50), --ObjectID int, Conditions nvarchar(max) as json ) t cross apply openjson(t.[Conditions]) with ( [Operator] varchar(25), [FieldTypeID] int, FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), [Value] nvarchar(500)--, --IntersectTypeID int, --TargetObject varchar(50), --TargetObjectID int ) ti;

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: insert into [security].RuleWhen select r.Id, row_number() over(partition by r.Id order by r.Id) as [Position], wi.CheckType, iif(wi.FieldTypeID > 0, wi.FieldTypeId, null) as FieldTypeId, iif(wi.IntersectTypeID > 0, wi.IntersectTypeID, null) as IntersectTypeId, iif( wi.IntersectTypeID > 0, 1, case wi.[Operator] when 'NotEquals' then 2 when 'Contains' then 3 when 'NotContains' then 4 when 'StartsWith' then 5 when 'EndsWith' then 6 when 'Before' then 7 when 'After' then 8 when 'Between' then 9 when 'Populated' then 10 when 'NotPopulated' then 11 when 'GreaterThan' then 12 when 'LessThanOrEquals' then 13 when 'LessThan' then 14 when 'GreaterThanOrEquals' then 15 when 'In' then 16 when 'NotIn' then 17 when 'IsTrue' then 18 when 'IsFalse' then 19 when 'OnOrBefore' then 20 when 'OnOrAfter' then 21 when 'IsInBand' then 22 else 1 end ) as [Operator], iif(wi.FieldTypeID > 0, wi.[Value], null) as [Value], a.Id as AssetId from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r cross apply openjson(r.Definition) with ( [When] nvarchar(max) as json ) w cross apply openjson(w.[When]) with ( [CheckType] char(1), [Operator] varchar(25), [FieldTypeID] int, FieldTypeName nvarchar(250), [Value] nvarchar(500), IntersectTypeID int, TargetObject varchar(50), TargetObjectID int ) wi left join Asset a on a.Object = wi.TargetObject and a.ObjectID = wi.TargetObjectID;

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: insert into [security].[Override] (RoleId, SecurityType, SecurityId, AssetId, Context, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn) select ResponsibilityTypeID, iif(SecurityAsset = 'G', 1, 2), SecurityAssetID, AssetID, Context, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem
